summary: Co-Array Fortran extends Fortran 95 with trailing square-bracket co-dimensions, so that remote data are named by image index and local data need no extra syntax. The paper gives the language specification and worked examples but reports no performance measurements.
why_read: It is the defining reference for the co-array model that later PGAS-style Fortran and UPC-style languages build on.
main_contribution: A minimal syntactic extension to Fortran 95 for one-sided, image-indexed data access with explicit synchronization intrinsics.
main_limitation: The paper gives no measured performance, and it leaves synchronization correctness and the runtime design to the programmer and implementer.
notes: The PDF prints no venue or year. The 1998 date is consistent with the catalog id and with the reference in chen2003upc, which gives it as RAL-TR-1998-060.
